name: Milfy Fasfar
original_name: ミルフィ・ファスファー
source:
★A curious and innocent magician apprentice★

A bright and easy-going girl.

She is small and has a young build for her age, and she is self-conscious about it.

She is curious and proactive, and acts as a leader among the curious students.

She makes no attempt to hide her feelings for Tsukasa and aggressively pursues him. At times, she even incites other students to approach Tsukasa as a group... She has a fairly high level of magical ability, but is not yet able to use it to her full potential.

[Translated from https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]
